reading_rule.confirmation: all three registered cases qualifying in one direction with settled, clean endpoints

descriptive.adjacent_time_similarity: adjacent-time hidden-state similarity is associated evidence only; no cosine threshold and no causal claim

ambiguous.reason: the ambiguous branch is registered and equally recorded; no continuation runs (the no-continuation policy) and no scope change is proposed

confirmed-improvement.reason: the hypothesis-supported branch is a registered technical ruling; continue under D-01

confirmed-worsening.reason: a refuted lead: the registered hypothesis is contradicted on all three cases, so a concrete owner proposal under SCOPE-49 is recorded before dependent work continues

inconclusive-mechanical.reason: an out-of-rule result routes to the owner under SCOPE-47; dependent work waits for the ruling

unsettled.reason: the unsettled branch is registered and equally recorded; no continuation runs (the no-continuation policy) and no scope change is proposed
